title: Emotes

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Emotes are character animations used to express feelings or change stance.
Emotes can be perfomed by using the emote radial menu. See Controls.
Emotes may be executed as a command through the developer console, but usually are performed using the in-game chat commands by pressing "Enter".

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
The only emote with function is the "Sit" emote, which can also be performed by pressing X, and allows resting near campfires.
The Mysterious Rock facial expressions can vary depending on the last player emotes. See the namesake page for details.
